name: dep_outdated
description: Manifest vs lockfile, offline: deps without lock entry, loose ranges, lock pins outside the spec (npm/py/go)

path.description: directory (manifests searched 2 levels deep, lockfile beside or above them) or one manifest file (default: project root)

limit.description: entries kept per list (unlocked, loose, mismatched, dev_only); default 200

data.locked: int (deps with a lock entry; requirements.txt without lock: its own == pins)
data.text: N deps, U unlocked, L loose, M mismatched
